channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam’s AI breakthrough: New ‘golden land’ in global race
item.description: With a compound annual growth rate forecast to reach nearly 40 percent during the 2025-31 period and ranking sixth worldwide in trust and adoption, Vietnam is rapidly emerging as a new ‘golden land’ in the global artificial intelligence race.

item.title: Two 18-year-olds arrested for New Year’s Eve jewelry store robbery in Vietnam
item.description: Police in Lam Dong Province, located in Vietnam’s Central Highlands, have arrested two 18-year-old suspects just 16 hours after they allegedly robbed a jewelry shop on Monday, the eve of the 2026 Lunar New Year (Tet).

item.title: Vietnam’s expanding global ties signal rising leadership, partnership opportunities: UN official
item.description: Pauline Tamesis, the United Nations Resident Coordinator in Vietnam, has affirmed that the country’s growing diplomatic network and balanced foreign policy position it as a bridge-builder in an increasingly divided world, while deeper cooperation with the UN will focus on climate action, inclusive development, and the transition toward a high-income, sustainable economy.

item.title: 21-seater bus driver, owner fined over $8,000 for exceeding passenger capacity in Vietnam
item.description: Police in Bac Ninh Province, northern Vietnam fined a bus operator and driver a total of US$8,390 on Wednesday after discovering a 21-seat passenger bus carrying 50 people, following a public tip-off and on-site inspection.

item.title: Vietnamese airlines sign $30-bln deals for 90 Boeing jets
item.description: Three Vietnamese airlines signed deals with U.S. manufacturer Boeing on Thursday to buy a total of 90 aircraft, as Vietnam and the United States continue negotiations on a new trade deal.

item.title: Canada revises express entry immigration rules, adds military roles
item.description: TORONTO -- Canada introduced new immigration priority categories on Wednesday to bring in skilled workers in fields ranging from research and health care to aviation, and to include certain military recruits.

item.title: Germany's Merz joins calls for social media limits for children
item.description: BERLIN -- Chancellor Friedrich Merz backed growing calls in Germany for controls on access to social media platforms by children, saying he had become increasingly persuaded of the need for compulsory limits by evidence of the harm done by the deliberate spreading of fake news and other forms of online manipulation.

item.title: Vietnam ranked world’s cheapest country for travel, expat living: French media
item.description: Vietnam has been ranked the world’s cheapest country for travel and expatriate living for the fifth consecutive year, with 89 percent of foreign respondents satisfied with the cost of living there, according to French news outlet Journal du Net, citing global surveys of foreign residents.

item.title: Vietnam's fresh food demand increases on second day of Lunar New Year
item.description: The domestic market has become more vibrant on the second day of the Lunar New Year (Tet) as shopping activity increases compared to the first day, reported the Agency for Domestic Market Surveillance and Development under the Ministry of Industry and Trade.
